GP01.name: EV Finance
GP01.purpose: Finance an EV purchase or replacement
intended_use_cases: Replace a customer-reported petrol or diesel vehicle
Purchase a first EV where a vehicle purchase use case is confirmed
exclusions: Existing EV with no replacement use case
GP01.sustainability_metric: Annual operational vehicle scenario comparison; lifecycle and financed emissions excluded

GP02.name: Green Home Loan
intended_use_cases: Owner-authorized energy-efficiency improvements to an occupied property
GP02.sustainability_metric: Annual operational energy scenario estimate; engineering assessment required

GP03.name: Solar Finance
intended_use_cases: Owner-authorized rooftop PV installation with a suitable roof and verified site yield
exclusions: Missing site data means impact is unavailable
GP03.sustainability_metric: Annual PV generation and displaced grid electricity; no export credit

GP04.name: Paperless Banking
GP04.purpose: Switch existing paper statements to digital delivery
intended_use_cases: Customer with paper statements who chooses digital delivery
GP04.sustainability_metric: Illustrative annual pages avoided; carbon unavailable without verified lifecycle factors
